question: Does a stateless receiver using several 25 km regions, disjoint early/late Doppler tracks and a withholding rule transfer to unseen receivers and reject offers that omit the true location?
inputs: Each case supplies a set of regional centers, an already formed anonymous track document, an observation UTC and a content-addressed causal TLE catalogue. This is a bounded candidate-region search. The caller supplies the coarse regions. The engine sees one case per isolated process.
primary_synthetic: Forty new receiver coordinates across at least eight previously untested regional centers. Pair matching true-present and true-missing offers on the same radio, each with four shuffled centers. Include neighboring and remote missing-region controls. The custodian selects and seals sites, epochs, nuisance and orbit conditions independently of engine outputs.
field: Test existing independent geographically referenced measured Starlink-compatible records with sufficient source and orbital provenance, including sparse sources where normal withholding can be evaluated. Record each source's upstream track selection, catalog completeness and date, and any conditioning on geography. Score each source separately.
recorded_control: Eight archived DS29 recordings at the previously studied installation, sampled without outcomes. Publish separately from independent physical sites.
freeze: Model developers may use analytic and previously published development fixtures. They do not access any current public or private test files. Commit the engine and runner before any holdout inference. Commit the public input tree and private truth digest for each panel before predicting it. Freeze predictions for every included panel before any truth is released or any label-based scoring.
containment: Each candidate is a WGS84 east/north square with half-width 12.5 km. Offers marked present contain the truth in exactly one region. Offers marked missing contain it in none.
outcomes: One operating point fixed before holdout. Status is fix or withheld. Evaluation includes all attempts. A forced-best diagnostic and region-only gate are scored separately from public coordinates. Count false publications on missing-region trials, published positions within 5 km of all present trials, and accepted position errors separately. Tabulate by source and site group. Sites and positive/negative trial pairs share observations.
calibration: Only within-track Doppler shape is used, so the constant RF-dependent term is mathematically removed. Use the same tracks, candidate offers and budgets in the c arms. During locked inference also repeat a predetermined subset with positive and negative RF calibration offsets and whole-track alias changes, and reverse the order of supplied regions. Compare outputs and RF scores independently of geographic accuracy.
target: One numerical thread per local worker. Report x86 elapsed time with explicit timing boundaries. No new RF and no target board in this study.
